correctness.rationale: Direct conjugation by commuting pairwise zz interactions gives exact mean spin <Jx>=n eta cos^(n-1)(tau)/2 and yz covariance Q, followed by independent single-qubit channel scaling only x,y. The minimum covariance eigenvalue is det(Q)/lambda_+; independent symbolic expansion confirmed H_n(tau): coefficient tau^2=1-n; tau^4=(n-1)(6n-11)/3; tau^6=(n-1)(15n^3-270n^2+945n-934)/90. Under tau=a n^(-3/5), eta=c n^(-1/5), eta^2 H_n -> c^2a^6/6 and lambda_+~c^2a^2n^(2/5), with uniform compact-parameter remainders. Hence limit 1/(c^4a^2)+a^4/(6c^2); unique positive minimum a=(3/c^2)^(1/6), threshold c*=(3^(2/3)/2)^(3/10). No global optimization over arbitrary time sequences or claim at equality finite n.
